title: Track hand-placed ~/.local/bin scripts in linux_configuration/scripts
objective: Every hand-placed script in ~/.local/bin (fix-execstack-launch.sh, nvidia-pmon-logger.sh, usage-report-catchup.sh, krita, blender-mcp-host, blender-mcp-serve, unreal-mcp-server) becomes a tracked file under linux_configuration/scripts/, and ~/.local/bin keeps a symlink with the original name so every caller (systemd user units, ~/.claude.json MCP config) still works. install_unreal_mcp.sh symlinks the launcher instead of generating it with a heredoc.
acceptance_criteria: readlink -f ~/.local/bin/<name> resolves to linux_configuration/scripts/<file> for all seven names (krita -> krita-scaled.sh)
bash -n passes for every tracked script; git ls-files -s shows mode 100755
install_launcher creates ~/.local/bin/unreal-mcp-server as a symlink to the tracked wrapper, idempotently, and chowns the link (not the target) under sudo
out_of_scope: Editing systemd units, crontab or MCP configs (symlinks keep their paths valid)
verifier: readlink -f + bash -n loop over ~/.local/bin entries; install_launcher run against a temp USER_HOME; pre-commit hooks on the staged files
